looking_for.en: Backend or platform engineering roles on product teams that own domain-heavy systems end to end — .NET Core or Golang, distributed services on Kubernetes. Open to remote or Taiwan-based.
looking_for.zh: 尋找由團隊端到端負責領域系統的後端／平台工程職位 — .NET Core 或 Golang、Kubernetes 上的分散式服務。可接受遠端或台灣在地。

summary.en: Backend and platform engineer with 4 years building microservices and domain-heavy systems across fintech and enterprise. Ships production .NET Core services with Clean Architecture, CQRS, and TDD, and runs them on Kubernetes (CKAD-certified) across Azure and Oracle Cloud. Led a credit-loan monolith into 10+ microservices and replaced a heavyweight spec process with a lighter workflow the team adopted across 3–4 projects. Writes Golang and ships open source outside work — 80+ articles across long-form technical series at Coding Afternoon (6.4K monthly unique visitors) and an ECC cryptography SDK with 2.7K NuGet downloads.
summary.zh: 4 年微服務與領域系統開發經驗的後端／平台工程師，橫跨金融科技與企業領域。以 Clean Architecture、CQRS 與 TDD 交付生產環境的 .NET Core 服務，並在 Azure 與 Oracle Cloud 的 Kubernetes 上營運（持有 CKAD 認證）。主導信用貸款單體系統拆分為 10 個以上微服務，並以自製的輕量流程取代過重的規格流程，獲團隊採用於 3 至 4 個專案。工作之外以 Golang 寫作與開源 — Coding Afternoon 累積 80 篇以上長篇技術系列文章（月不重複訪客 6.4K），並發布下載數 2.7K 的 ECC 密碼學 SDK。

details.en: Built the .NET Core backends powering a global vehicle-care platform's Taiwan-market expansion, with Clean Architecture, CQRS, and TDD.
details.zh: 建置支撐全球車輛護理平台台灣市場擴張的 .NET Core 後端，採用 Clean Architecture、CQRS 與 TDD。

achievements.en: Architected and built the CRM Client-360 platform end to end — six domains (Client, Vehicle, Appointment, Budget, WorkOrder, Invoice) as MediatR vertical slices with multi-tenant isolation; now in trial operation ahead of the Taiwan launch
achievements.zh: 端到端建置 CRM 客戶 360 平台 — 六個領域（Client、Vehicle、Appointment、Budget、WorkOrder、Invoice）以 MediatR 垂直切片實作並具多租戶隔離；目前試營運中，準備台灣上線

achievements.en: Delivered the Taiwan market's primary customer channel by owning the LINE Messaging API integration end to end: HMAC-verified webhooks, link-code account binding, Flex-card messaging, and Hangfire-scheduled appointment notifications
achievements.zh: 端到端負責 LINE Messaging API 整合，交付台灣市場的主要客戶溝通管道：HMAC 簽章驗證 webhook、link-code 帳號綁定、Flex 卡片訊息，以及 Hangfire 排程的預約通知

achievements.en: Eliminated duplicate charges from concurrent checkout with an atomic conditional-update transaction state machine, and shipped the full e-invoicing lifecycle (issue / void / allowance) with rollback on provider failure
achievements.zh: 以原子條件更新的交易狀態機消除併發結帳造成的重複扣款，並交付完整電子發票生命週期（開立／作廢／折讓），含 provider 失敗時的回滾機制

achievements.en: Made one codebase serve two markets by designing country-dispatched document validators (Spanish DNI/NIE vs Taiwan ID and business number), a country-scoped document catalog, and Taiwan tire-specification attributes
achievements.zh: 設計依國別分派的證件驗證器（西班牙 DNI/NIE 對台灣身分證與統一編號）、國別範圍的證件目錄與台灣輪胎規格欄位，使單一程式碼庫可同時服務兩個市場

achievements.en: Established the cross-cutting infrastructure the whole platform relies on: EF Core interceptors for field-level audit logging and workshop-scoped license-plate uniqueness, plus role and module-level access control
achievements.zh: 打造全平台共用的跨切面基礎建設：以 EF Core 攔截器實作欄位級稽核日誌與工作坊範圍的車牌唯一性，以及角色與模組層級的權限控管

details.en: Migrated a credit-loan platform to microservices, built out its Oracle Cloud infrastructure, and introduced spec-driven development to the team.
details.zh: 將信用貸款平台遷移至微服務，建置其 Oracle Cloud 基礎設施，並為團隊導入規格驅動開發。

achievements.en: Migrated the credit-loan monolith into 10+ microservices, then redesigned the strategy module to separate business rules from loan processing — new loan rules now ship without touching core flows
achievements.zh: 將信用貸款單體系統拆分為 10 個以上微服務，並重新設計策略模組，將業務規則與貸款處理邏輯分離 — 新增貸款規則不再需要動到核心流程

achievements.en: Introduced spec-driven development to the team: piloted GitHub Spec Kit, found it too process-heavy in practice, and built a lighter-weight workflow the team adopted across 3–4 projects and that I use on all my open-source work
achievements.zh: 為團隊導入規格驅動開發：先以 GitHub Spec Kit 試行，實務上發現流程過重，因而自製更輕量的工作流程，獲團隊採用於 3 至 4 個專案，我自己的開源專案也全數採用

achievements.en: Implemented shared SSO/OAuth authentication so internal services stopped maintaining their own login paths
achievements.zh: 實作跨內部服務共用的 SSO/OAuth 認證，使各服務不再各自維護登入流程

achievements.en: Automated CI/CD with Azure DevOps and ran production services on Oracle Cloud (OCP), with reproducible local test environments (OracleDB, Redis, identity services) so features could be verified before merge
achievements.zh: 以 Azure DevOps 自動化 CI/CD 並在 Oracle Cloud (OCP) 營運生產服務，同時建置可復現的本地測試環境（OracleDB、Redis、身分服務），讓功能在合併前即可驗證

details.en: Payment processing and third-party API integrations, built with TDD and hexagonal architecture.
details.zh: 支付處理與第三方 API 整合，以 TDD 與六邊形架構開發。

achievements.en: Led a 4–6 person intern team as Scrum Master, running workshops on hexagonal architecture, TDD, refactoring, Docker, and Kubernetes
achievements.zh: 以 Scrum Master 身分帶領 4 至 6 人的實習生團隊，並舉辦六邊形架構、TDD、重構、Docker 與 Kubernetes 工作坊

achievements.en: Cut production issue detection from hours to minutes by building ELK monitoring across the Kubernetes services
achievements.zh: 為 Kubernetes 服務建置 ELK 監控，將生產問題的發現時間從數小時縮短至數分鐘

achievements.en: Refactored legacy payment code and closed defects that had stayed open for more than two years
achievements.zh: 重構遺留的支付程式碼，並修復懸置超過兩年的缺陷

achievements.en: Spoke twice at GDG Kaohsiung on Golang and developer tooling
achievements.zh: 在 GDG Kaohsiung 發表兩場演講，主題為 Golang 與開發工具

details.en: Tech-education blog at coding-afternoon.com — content, site, and infrastructure, all solo.
details.zh: 技術教育部落格 coding-afternoon.com — 內容、網站與基礎設施皆獨力完成。

achievements.en: Published 80+ articles across long-form technical series on Golang (design patterns, goroutine concurrency, TDD with AI), .NET, and blockchain; the site now serves 6,390 unique visitors and 51,660 requests a month
achievements.zh: 以長篇技術系列發表 80 篇以上文章，涵蓋 Golang（設計模式、Goroutine 並發、AI 輔助 TDD）、.NET 與區塊鏈；網站目前月不重複訪客 6,390 位、月請求數 51,660 次

achievements.zh: 開源 EccSDK，一套發布於 NuGet 的橢圓曲線密碼學 SDK — 累計下載數 2.7K
